name: Total
code: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM items

name: Comunidades
code: SELECT community,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY community ORDER BY total DESC

name: Fontes
code: SELECT source,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY source

name: Dias
code: SELECT substr(captured_at,1,10) AS dia,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY dia ORDER BY dia

name: Python
code: SELECT id,title FROM items WHERE lower(body) LIKE '%python%' LIMIT 100

name: RAG
code: SELECT id,title FROM items WHERE lower(body) LIKE '%rag%' LIMIT 100

name: Links
code: SELECT id,title FROM items WHERE body LIKE '%https://%' LIMIT 100

name: Textos vazios
code: SELECT id,title FROM items WHERE body IS NULL OR length(trim(body))=0 LIMIT 100
